# MelodyMind Stories

> AI-assisted, human-reviewed English-language long-form music journalism from MelodyMind.

- [Home](https://stories.melody-mind.de/): Twenty-eight-story reading room and featured stories
- [The Record Held the Contradiction](https://stories.melody-mind.de/the-record-held-the-contradiction/): Scene report on Tropicália's collective arrangements, television stages, mass culture, and political pressure
- [The Song Changed When the Room Answered](https://stories.melody-mind.de/the-song-changed-when-the-room-answered/): Artist portrait of Umm Kulthum's responsive long-form concert practice, orchestra, audience, and radio public
- [The Store Became the Label](https://stories.melody-mind.de/the-store-became-the-label/): Scene report on Cogumelo Records and Belo Horizonte's early extreme-metal network
- [The X Stayed on the Hand](https://stories.melody-mind.de/the-x-stayed-on-the-hand/): Scene report on all-ages access, Dischord Records, zines, and citizen archiving in Washington hardcore
- [The Bar Line Stayed Put](https://stories.melody-mind.de/the-bar-line-stayed-put/): Artist portrait of Meshuggah's stable pulse, displaced riff cycles, and extended-range guitar language
- [The Room Charged by the Hour](https://stories.melody-mind.de/the-room-charged-by-the-hour/): Scene report on Reciprocal Recording, Jack Endino, Sub Pop, and Seattle's early independent recording network
- [The Sample Had a Screen](https://stories.melody-mind.de/the-sample-had-a-screen/): Technology story about the Fairlight CMI, digital sampling, light-pen editing, and Page R sequencing
- [The Band Was the Arrangement](https://stories.melody-mind.de/the-band-was-the-arrangement/): Artist portrait of Fela Kuti and Africa 70 as an interlocking musical and political system
- [The Voice Inside the Beat](https://stories.melody-mind.de/the-voice-inside-the-beat/): Artist portrait of Missy Elliott's vocal arranging, songwriting, production, and visual authorship
- [The Mix Was Still Being Written](https://stories.melody-mind.de/the-mix-was-still-being-written/): Artist portrait of Lee “Scratch” Perry's Black Ark recording and dub practice
- [The Studio That Counted Every Hook](https://stories.melody-mind.de/the-studio-that-counted-every-hook/): Technology story about Cheiron Studios and collaborative Swedish pop production
- [Three Minutes at 1650 Broadway](https://stories.melody-mind.de/three-minutes-at-1650-broadway/): Scene report on the songwriting labor and publishing network behind Brill Building pop
- [Four Parts, One Weight](https://stories.melody-mind.de/four-parts-one-weight/): Artist portrait of Black Sabbath as a four-person musical system
- [The Workshop Inside the Guitar](https://stories.melody-mind.de/the-workshop-inside-the-guitar/): Artist portrait of Eddie Van Halen as player, builder, and technical problem-solver
- [The New Wave Was a Network](https://stories.melody-mind.de/the-new-wave-was-a-network/): Scene report on the decentralized infrastructure of NWOBHM
- [Tape Traders at the Front Row](https://stories.melody-mind.de/tape-traders-at-the-front-row/): Scene report on the Bay Area thrash network
- [What the Stack Changed](https://stories.melody-mind.de/what-the-stack-changed/): Technology story about Marshall amplification, distortion, and stage architecture
- [All Four Knobs to the Right](https://stories.melody-mind.de/all-four-knobs-to-the-right/): Technology story about the BOSS HM-2 and Stockholm death metal
- [The Guitar Before Rock Had a Name](https://stories.melody-mind.de/the-guitar-before-rock-had-a-name/): Artist portrait of Sister Rosetta Tharpe
- [Manchester, FAC 1 to FAC 51](https://stories.melody-mind.de/manchester-fac-1-to-fac-51/): Scene report on Factory's early Manchester network
- [One Hundred Pulses, No Band Name](https://stories.melody-mind.de/one-hundred-pulses-no-band-name/): Cover story on Unknown Pleasures
- [The Business in Ma Rainey's Voice](https://stories.melody-mind.de/the-business-in-ma-raineys-voice/): Artist portrait of Ma Rainey's touring and recording work
- [Five Strings, No Drummer](https://stories.melody-mind.de/five-strings-no-drummer/): Artist portrait of Django Reinhardt and the Hot Club quintet
- [Forty-Five Seconds of Room](https://stories.melody-mind.de/forty-five-seconds-of-room/): Artist portrait of Pauline Oliveros and Deep Listening
- [A Jazz History at the Keyboard](https://stories.melody-mind.de/a-jazz-history-at-the-keyboard/): Artist portrait of Mary Lou Williams
- [The Room Before the Record](https://stories.melody-mind.de/the-room-before-the-record/): Scene report on Chicago house
- [Belleville to Metroplex](https://stories.melody-mind.de/belleville-to-metroplex/): Scene report on Detroit techno
- [How to Play a Record Without Language](https://stories.melody-mind.de/how-to-play-a-record-without-language/): Annotated cover story on the Voyager Golden Record
- [AI transparency](https://stories.melody-mind.de/about/#ai-transparency): Editorial method, human review, AI disclosure, and privacy
- [RSS](https://stories.melody-mind.de/rss.xml): Story feed

Each article includes numbered sources, image rights, an editorial disclosure, and
Article JSON-LD. MelodyMind Stories has no accounts, analytics, cookies, external
embeds, or browser storage.
